question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec9225cfc38729804aee62641c7181da2f5fd0b2e90e5de425ddc63993411ee0.png]
solution: The number of triangles in the given figure are shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = [4 × (1 + 4)] ÷ 2 = [4 × 5] ÷ 2 = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5236554d2cec3d13d76c44d46678dfaf7f0dd4392837f93c39cf6307cc12fd56.png]
